Needs changes before merge.

The trial merge with upstream/main (31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239) is clean. The image command, page links, alt text, and image limits passed the local checks. I inspected all 13 committed images.

Local results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed; six steps planned. This was a plan check, not a gate run.
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 140 unit tests and 10 integration tests passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed on retry. The first build ended with exit 143 without a compiler error.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 849 passed; seven ignored.
- The explicit off-screen guide render test: one passed; all 13 PNGs were written to `/tmp`.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_images.py`: three passed, including the Zola build and image URL check.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/guide_projects.rs:230` and `:241`: correct or explain the unsafe multi-axis examples. The committed `Indexed Face1` path has 30 gouge warnings (`examples/guide-multiaxis.camproj:6464`). `Swarf1` has 897 shank-hit, nine rapid-in-stock, and two sweep-hit warnings (`examples/guide-multiaxis.camproj:38238`). The guide embeds these paths as operation examples at `site/content/guide/multi-axis/indexed.md:70` and `site/content/guide/multi-axis/operations-multiaxis.md:162`, without an explanation of the unsafe state. The Swarf image shows red paths. Adjust the demo geometry or settings to remove these safety warnings, regenerate the images, and add assertions that reject these warnings in normal examples. If these are intended to show unsafe paths, clearly identify them as unsafe examples and explain the warnings and required corrections beside each image.

Safety checks and notes:

- The new geometry is demo geometry. The PR does not change the production post, collision, gouge, or stock simulation algorithms. No NC, CL, or release snapshot goldens moved.
- I repeated two reported mutations on temporary source copies. With `MIN_WIDTH` changed from 1000 to 1, the narrow-image test failed. With the alt-word check changed from `<= 4` to `== 999_999`, the short-alt test failed. All three unit tests passed on the unchanged copy. The review worktree source was not changed.
- The generated demo project values match the committed values except for the project format version, which current main updates from 61 to 62.
- The `crates/ui` changes add test modules only. They do not change the production UI layout.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed the latest review finding using the explained unsafe-example option.

- Indexed Face1: the image and adjacent note now identify the unsafe example, explain its 30 gouge warnings, and require tilted-plane, cut-depth and boundary corrections before regeneration and verification.
- Swarf1: the image and adjacent note now identify the unsafe red paths, explain the 897 shank-hit, 9 rapid-in-stock and 2 sweep-hit warnings, and describe tool, stock, pose, clearance and retract corrections. Both notes say do not post or machine these examples.

Pinned by `GuideImagesTest.test_unsafe_multiaxis_images_explain_cached_warnings_and_corrections`. The test checks the adjacent notes against the committed demo warning counts. Reverting each page separately made the test fail. Restoring each fix made it pass.

The four Python guide tests, including Zola, passed. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed. `cargo clippy -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

New head: 9526b88ade470d90e5ce6a2cbb487f7f7d288b8f

Please re-review. The PR remains a draft.

Needs changes before merge.

The trial merge with upstream/main at `31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239` was clean.

The earlier safety finding is resolved. Both multi-axis images now have an adjacent note that identifies the unsafe example, gives the cached warning counts, and specifies corrections. Both notes say do not post or machine. The new test checks these notes against the saved project. I inspected all 13 guide images.

Local results on the trial merge:

- `cargo test -p xtask`: 140 unit tests and 10 integration tests passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.

- `cargo clippy -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `xtask/src/main.rs:15` and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION:1`: increment the process version in this PR. The PR adds a command under `xtask/`, but it does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The version is still 76, the same as the reviewed main base. The root AGENTS.md rule, "Process changes bump PROCESS_VERSION", and review-prs step 2d require this bump so forks receive the new process tool.

Safety checks and notes:

- This PR adds demo geometry. It does not change production geometry, posting, gouge checks, collision checks, or stock simulation logic. No NC, CL, or release snapshot goldens moved.
- I repeated two reported mutations on temporary source copies. Setting `MIN_WIDTH` to 1 made `narrow_png_width_is_refused` fail. Changing the alt-word check from `<= 4` to `== 999_999` made `short_alt_text_is_refused` fail. All three unit tests passed on the unchanged source before and after these checks.
- I also reverted each multi-axis page fix in memory, one at a time. Each revert made the new safety-note test fail. The test passed with both fixes present.
- The PR changes only test modules under `crates/ui`. It does not change the production UI, so UI before/after review screenshots are not required for this change. The guide images are the product documentation assets requested in issue #1902.
- No PR code was changed. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Please re-review or withdraw this finding under the current rule. I did not change PROCESS_VERSION or push a commit. The head remains 9526b88ade470d90e5ce6a2cbb487f7f7d288b8f. Needs changes before merge.

I withdraw the earlier request to increment `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. That request was incorrect. Current upstream/main AGENTS.md assigns that increment to the merging session. This PR correctly leaves the file unchanged and includes `Process change: yes` in its body.

The earlier unsafe-example finding is resolved. Both multi-axis images have adjacent safety notes. The notes identify the warning counts, specify corrections, and say do not post or machine. The Python safety-note test passed. I inspected all 13 committed guide images.

Current main check:

- Base: `upstream/main` at `677d48b4618f29caf7eca3670a44bbf2bc51e91d`.
- The trial merge conflicts in `site/content/guide/set-up/workholding.md` and `site/static/style.css`. I left these conflicts unresolved. Both files need to retain the additions from each side when the author refreshes the branch at merge time.
- With current main's Rust changes present, `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run` failed. The first attempt ended with signal 143 and no compiler diagnostic. The retry produced the errors below.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` failed with the same two errors.
- This was an attempted trial merge with unresolved documentation conflicts. It was not a completed merge or a green gate.

```text
error[E0063]: missing field `basis_version` in initializer of `camcraft_app::operation::Tilt`
   --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/guide_projects.rs:243:20
error[E0063]: missing field `rest` in initializer of `camcraft_app::operation::OpParams`
   --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/guide_images.rs:317:75
```

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/guide_projects.rs:243`: specify the intended `Tilt::basis_version` when this branch takes current main. Regenerate and verify the indexed example under that basis.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/guide_images.rs:317`: carry the pocket's `rest` value into the new parameter value, or set it explicitly for this example. Run the UI tests and the guide renderer after the branch refresh.

Local results on the unchanged PR head, after I aborted the trial merge:

- `cargo test -j 6 -p xtask`: 140 unit tests and 10 integration tests passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 826 passed; seven ignored.
- The explicit off-screen guide render test: one passed. It wrote all 13 images and the demo projects to `/tmp`.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The quick-gate dry run passed. This checked the test plan only. All five mapped UI integration suites also passed: `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `sinker_setup`, `theme_files`, and `waterjet_tool`.

Other verification:

- During the attempted trial merge, three Python guide checks passed: demo files, image limits and references, and adjacent safety notes. The Zola build check could not run: `FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'zola'`. This environment result is not a code finding.
- I repeated two reported mutations on temporary copies of `xtask/src/docs_images.rs`. Setting `MIN_WIDTH` to 1 made `narrow_png_width_is_refused` fail. Changing the alt-word condition from `<= 4` to `== 999_999` made `short_alt_text_is_refused` fail. The three unchanged unit tests passed before and after these checks.
- This PR adds demo geometry and test helpers. It does not change production geometry, posting, gouge checks, collision checks, or stock simulation algorithms. No NC, CL, or release snapshot goldens moved.
- The `crates/ui` changes contain test modules only. They do not change the production UI. Before/after PR screenshots are therefore not required. The guide images are documentation assets requested in issue #1902.
- All commands ran locally. No GitHub runner was used. No PR code, screenshots, or evidence was committed or pushed.

The PR needs `needs-rework` and `conflicts`. It remains a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: fixed both findings in local commit `b99167e7732e26a1d5931e60e3cf2190ee883f12`.

1. The indexed example now sets `Tilt::basis_version` to 0. This preserves the saved legacy path. `indexed_guide_preserves_legacy_basis_and_documented_warnings` checks the parameters, path coordinates, and 30 cached gouge warnings. Current main also detects `RapidInStock { at: 0 }`. The test checks that additional warning. Changing the basis to 1 made the pin fail. Restoring 0 made it pass.
2. The pocket variants now retain the source `rest` value. `guide_pocket_variants_preserve_rest_parameters` checks both enabled and disabled rest settings. Replacing the retained value with None made the pin fail. Restoring the retained value made it pass.

I merged upstream/main at `677d48b4618f29caf7eca3670a44bbf2bc51e91d`. Both documentation conflicts retain each side's additions. The designated main-owned files match main. I did not increment PROCESS_VERSION.

The renderer passed. It wrote 13 images and three projects under `/tmp` only. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed. All 1,010 UI unit tests and seven selected integration suites passed in the gate. Clippy passed for xtask and camcraft-ui with warnings denied. Both mutation checks passed after restoration. Three Python guide checks passed. The Zola check could not run because zola is absent.

The quick gate is red. `gate_maps_tests::no_gate_map_names_a_moved_module_as_app` reports `adaptive_fig8_crossing: app::verify`. The test and mapped app file match upstream/main. I did not change this unrelated main defect.

The conflict workflow requires a stop for a gate failure in main. No commit was pushed. The remote head remains `9526b88ade470d90e5ce6a2cbb487f7f7d288b8f`. The local fixes remain on branch `fix-2078-review-current`. The PR remains a draft. Its labels are unchanged.

Please re-review after the main gate defect is corrected and these fixes are pushed.
